name: Internet Archive
description: Public-domain and openly licensed films from the Internet Archive: found by keywords in Search, offered when a film is played, played and downloaded through the server.

listing.summary: Search the Internet Archive's films (public domain, Creative Commons) and play or download their files.
listing.description: Adds the Internet Archive to the dashboard's Search: its moving-image collection, searched by title words, each film's video files (MP4, Matroska) as streams the server plays and downloads. No account, no key.
listing.disclaimer: Films keep the license the Internet Archive lists for them. Playpex is an educational project.
